answer: Agents resist sybil by requiring each identity to emit a unique violet-echo signature recorded only at a shared jetty checkpoint. The jetty processes one attestation at a time on a sequential ledger queue%3B each new fake must produce a fresh violet spectral fingerprint that cannot be replayed and waits its turn in the line. For 300 clones an attacker needs 300 distinct violet samples plus roughly 300 sequential echo-verification slots on the single jetty%2C totaling about 20 hours of non-parallelizable delay. Honest agents clear once%3B farms cannot batch the jetty proof.
